Chocolate Wafer-Cookie Dessert
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, December 14, 2009 - 7:39am

Ingredients




1 pt. whipping cream, sweetened to taste
1 box chocolate wafer cookies
Maraschino cherries, drained

Preparation

1 Whip the cream until stiff. Add sugar to taste. Place a tablespoon of the sweetened cream on each of 12 wafer cookies, on a flat cookie sheet. Top with another wafer and spoonful of cream. Continue alternating the wafers and cream until you have three layers, ending with a spoonful of cream. 2 Top each stack with a maraschino cherry and refrigerate overnight. The whipped cream will soften up the cookies, so they will be individual tortes. Our children call them "Zebra Haystacks".
